SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEP_SEQ FROM kep.IF_FILE_UC WHERE BUYER = 'KRKEPB0004' AND DOC_TYPE = 'IVDT' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY KEP_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT key_no as LEGACY_INV_NO , key_seq as LEGACY_INV_SEQ , data01 as BUYER_ITEM_NO , data02 as DESCRIPTION , data03 as SPECIFICATION , data04 as DIMESION , f_split(data05,'^',1) as UNIT_MEASURE , f_split(data05,'^',2) as INV_QTY , f_split(data05,'^',3) as UNIT_PRICE , f_split(data05,'^',4) as ITEM_AMT , f_split(data05,'^',5) as LEGACY_PO_NO , f_split(data05,'^',6) as LEGACY_PO_SEQ FROM kep.IF_FILE_UC WHERE KEP_SEQ = $G_RS.KEP_SEQ$
UPDATE kep.IF_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(sysdate,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = $G_RS.KEP_SEQ$
UPDATE kep.IF_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(sysdate,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = $G_RS.KEP_SEQ$
